summary: MDJM LTD disclosed via Form 6-K that Nasdaq's Listing Council affirmed the Hearings Panel's May 14, 2026 decision to delist the Company's Class A ordinary shares. The Nasdaq Board declined further review on July 28, 2026, making the delisting final per Listing Rule 5820(e)(6). Nasdaq will remove shares under Rule 5830 and Rule 12d2-2. The shares currently trade on OTCQB under 'UOKAF'. No deal terms apply; the event is the final regulatory determination ending the Company's Nasdaq listing, with continued OTC trading to watch.
